aise-my-five-supernatural-wives:
Tired of the same old fantasy novel where the protagonist gets a cheat system and a pokemon harem? Well, this story is for you. You know the cliché: guy gets bitten by some yandere vampire and becomes the strongest Vampire.
But there's a big difference in this one.
Here due to a mix-up in the ritual—because even supernatural rituals can have glitches—our main character Valerian gets the ultimate power-up... and five very Beautiful wives.
That’s right, Valerian is now married to women of five different races: a Vampire, a Werewolf, a Witch, a Succubus, and a Druid. Each one a powerful, beautiful, and utterly possessive woman who believes she has a claim to him.
Valerian isn't fighting monsters; he's fighting for his sanity and personal space.
This isn't a story where the hero falls head over heels right away; this is a battle of wits and wills.
This is the story of Valerian, a guy who had a normal? life until an mysterious being called author started writing 'Prologue' and turned his world into a twisted reality.
.......
Our protagonist is no ordinary MC. He's cold, ruthless, and hard to get. He won't be stupid, but you can expect some glorious mistakes.
So, about the NTR stuff.…
all-the-female-disciples-want-to-kill-me:
Su Bei sat on No-Sword Peak, contentedly watching his female disciple scurry about.
That would have completed his first task for his System Quest assigned by “The Highest Ten Thousand Fold Feedback for Discipleship” system!
Xia Ruoching looked at Su Bei with a serious face,
“Master, this is the spiritual fruit I got from the Sect Leader. He said it'd be helpful for your injuries!”
Su Bei gazed at the half-black, half-red fruit in front of him and fell into deep thought.
“Are you sure this is what the fruit looks like?”
“......”
“This is the real deal, Master! That half is definitely not poisoned! Eating this spiritual fruit would be such a wonderful experience, ah!”
“?”
“......”
Years later.
Su Bei, while leading one of his many disciples back to Sword Sect, suddenly sneezed and muttered,
“That's strange. Why do I keep feeling like a bunch of people are cursing me?”
The eldest disciple looked at the new junior sisters with a stunned expression, “What? You want to kill Master too?”
......
The book is also known as “I Have the Highest Ten Thousand Fold Feedback System for Discipleship.…
antihero-in-the-hero-academy-i-can-conne:
There was nothing left to lose in his life.
He had lived as a hero. He had started at the bottom and worked his way up to the top, at the end he become the best, yet he had always been betrayed by those he had tried to protect.
Humanity did not deserve his protection.
When everything went out and he could no longer even hope to beg for his life, he could do nothing but look up at the blood-red sky among the corpses of demons and angels.
He wished for one more chance, just one more chance.
And when that chance was given to him, he swore that he would change everything. He would no longer be a hero to save people, but an anti-hero to save the world.
Sacrificing hundreds of people to save an elf, poisoning hundreds of people to save a group of half-demons.
He didn't care about any of that anymore, he would protect those he cared about and send everything else to hell.
Not even the gods or goddesses could stop him.
assistant-manager-kim-hates-idols:
Not only does he have to fangirl on behalf of the manager’s daughter, but now he has to debut as an idol himself?
Assistant Manager Kim really hates idols.
comprehending-myriad-techniques-as-woodc:
Xie Yuan went up a mountain to pray for a top-tier fortune stick to help his studies, but unexpectedly transmigrated to a cultivation world, becoming an impoverished woodcutter.
He thought it would be hard to turn his life around, but never expected the fortune stick he prayed for was actually real.
【Chop Wood 100,000 times, and you have comprehended “Mountain-Splitting Blow”.】
From then on, Xie Yuan was unstoppable.
From the common [Iron Cloth Shirt], to the top-secret Buddhist technique [Indestructible Golden Bell Shield];
From the incomplete Cultivation Technique [Black Celestial Book], to the legendary, world-lost Divine Skill [General Principles of the Celestial Book];
From the obscure and hard-to-understand [Pre-Qin Fangshi's Manuscripts], to the orthodox immortal method pointing directly to the Great Dao, [Supreme Clarity Scripture of Dao and De]…
conquering-the-novel:
When Ares wakes up, he finds himself in a familiar world but in an unfamiliar body. It was a world he'd read about in a novel he discovered among the belongings of his late girlfriend.
But when he ended up in a novel that he had just finished reading before dying, his life changed for the better or the worse.
Why are all women crazy about me? Why are they pursuing me while ignoring the main character?
Join Ares on his journey through the novel to solve the mystery of his death and learn the truth about the world he ended up in.
divorce-revenge-system-knowing-the-futur:
A person in their third year of high school, experiences the arrival of a divorce comeback system 20 years early.
At 38 years old, with a failed marriage, standing at the crossroads of the established and confused years, you recall your young days with your childhood sweetheart.
After marriage, you cut off contact and have no more news of her.
Re-establishing contact with Xu Qianqian will reward you with 300 RMB.
Eighteen-year-old Jiang Nian glanced at the system task on the panel and then at Xu Qianqian living next door, falling into deep thought. Hmm...
it seems the system came early. There is another issue: who is the future ex-wife?
Hmm... Jiang Nian couldn't hold back. Being eighteen every year, he foresees a divorce in the future.
The system issues a task to take revenge on the future ex-wife. Jiang Nian looked at the un-darkened version of the future ex-wife in front of him and fell into thought again.
The childhood sweetheart, future ex-wife, and future ex-girlfriend, all appear in their younger versions.
exorcists-self-cultivation:
“Thanks for the invite, I’m in New York, just got off the plane.”
Du Wei realized he had traveled through time.
Having no choice, he had to resume his old trade and opened a psychological consultation clinic, but the patients seeking psychological advice were all a bit strange...
how-can-i-justify-myself-as-a-magnate-if:
People are inevitably troubled all their life by the things they couldn’t have when they were young, but if you were driving a Bentley in your youth, life would be like playing a game...
... ...
In this era of information explosion, the struggles of ordinary people are like being placed under the spotlight, turning into monkey shows for entertainment displayed before everyone...
However, while some people are watching for fun, even more are looking in a mirror...
Gu Heng, who was pulled out of the mire by the system, began to experience the thrill of indulgence.
i-play-a-evil-god-in-otome-game:
What will an ordinary man do if he finds out he is God in an Otome game?
Of course, save the game’s Evil character, Morrigan! Unknowingly spread more chaos! Establish your own kingdom! Establish your own religion! Kill the Goddess of Light!
i-transmigrated-into-a-novel-and-became-:
# COZY # OMNIPOTENT # CHIEFASSISTANT
In her past life, Mo Ruyue was a top-notch assassin. She was as indifferent as an abyss, and had killed more people than she had fingers to count. In her new life, she became the vicious stepmother of five munchkins in a remote mountain valley, and they were terrified of her. In this life, she decided to change the way she lived. She only had four bare walls for a house? Her children starved to the point they were just skin and bones? No problem. She could kill wild boars with her bare hands, so food wasn’t an issue. She was also proficient in multiplication tables, and her kids instantly became big fans of hers. It had been a difficult journey to change from a vicious stepmother to a warm one. Then, her supposedly dead husband suddenly returned, now the first minister of the dynasty.“Let’s divorce. Give me the children, and I’ll return the money to you.” “I don’t lack anything, just you and the children.”
investing-in-the-three-villainesses-give:
Elias is the weakest son of the Crimson Duke, treated as disposable because he possesses no talent for the sword. His family finally gives him one chance to prove his worth: marry three women everyone considered cursed.
The first has been burned by her own power and left mute and deaf.
The second has been poisoned so badly that she couldn't even move her limbs.
The third has gone insane after her entire clan was annihilated.
Everyone expects Elias to abandon them.
Instead—
[Ding! Infinite Investment System Activated.]
Every action, every goodwill by Elias toward his wives rewards him multiplefold.
But Elias discovers something terrifying.
These aren't ordinary women.
They are the three future Calamities who would eventually destroy the continent.
The man whom they threw away as useless would soon return as someone beyond their comprehension.
leisurely-traveler-with-check-in-system:
After binding with the check-in system, Li Younan bid farewell to the cubicle. While others are anxiously hitting KPIs, he strolled in the misty rain of Jiangnan, leisurely watched the sunset in the Dunhuang desert, and completed a yoga check-in in the hot springs of Changbai Mountain.
[Check-in complete, Cooking skill +1]
[Check-in complete, Painting skill +1]
[Check-in complete, Photography skill +1]
[Check-in complete, Driving skill +1]
lifespan-burning-system-master-everythin:
In a world where everyone awakens a Trait to start their cultivation, Rhys's was considered a joke: he would never age.
In a world that worships raw combat power, a Trait granting eternal youth was worthless. To his powerful family, Rhys was a talentless failure, a stain on their name. With disgust, they cast him out onto the streets, leaving him with nothing.
Alone and powerless, Rhys's life was shattered when he was caught in the crossfire of a terrifying battle between two god-like cultivators.
Mortally wounded and left to bleed out in an alley, he faced a lonely, pathetic end.
But as Rhys's vision faded and his last breath drew near, a new power roared to life within him.
[Lifespan Burning System Activated]
Suddenly, his useless Trait became Rhys's greatest weapon. His infinite lifespan was now the ultimate fuel source.
A divine martial art that takes a genius a hundred years to master?
[Consume 100 years of lifespan. Skill comprehended to Maximum Level.]
A fatal wound that no healer can mend?
[Consume 10 years of lifespan. Body restored to peak condition.]
An ancient, unreadable text holding the world's greatest secrets?
[Consume 500 years of lifespan.…
lust-knight:
Lucien, a guy who has nothing but the desire to save his mother. To get strong enough, he makes a contract with the demon of L.u.s.t. And now, only by making a great harem, will he gain the power to protect those dear to him.
Warning:
This story contains s.e.x.u.a.l content. It’s still a fantasy adventure (no reincarnation or system), but if you don’t want to read a lot of s.e.x scenes, don’t try it.
Author’s note:
I don’t consider myself good now, but a complete beginner. I hope to improve with each chapter, both my writing and story. I really hope you enjoy it. Any idea or comment is welcome.
mage-adam:
Living things really are ignorant – the greed to obtain the key to knowledge and the fundamentals of energy overpowers them.
Little do they know that knowledge is full of lies and energy is the root of destruction.
Us, mages, have mastered travelling through space and time. We are invincible, we can turn worlds into dust and you, mere ants, will be wiped out with no trace.
-Mage Adam An A.I.(Artificial Intelligence) gets reincarnated into a world where he becomes a mage.
miracle-throne:
The youngest Wiseman of the continent, Chu Tian, has traveled 30,000 years back in time to the age of antiquity due to an accident.
This is a prosperous era. Rare herbs, minerals, treasure relics and monsters can be easily found throughout the land.
However, this is also an undeveloped era. Communications, traffic, martial arts and technology are in its early stage of development. Prosperous cities lack lighting while its citizens are uneducated.
Our decisive MC using his future knowledge creates Magic powered light bulbs, magic powered telephones, magic powered cannons, magic powered computers, artificial intelligence, psyche internet. 30,000 years worth of knowledge allows him to create miracles and shine brightly in this era. Allowing him to conquer the land and sit firmly on the throne of the 10 realms.
my-doctor-son-in-law-clarence:
Clarence, a man married into the Murphy family, was disliked by all his in-laws, his wife, and was facing the possible fate of divorce.
All because he was an orphan and was not highly educated.
But in truth, he was actually the young master of one of the wealthiest families in the world.
And one day, he gained a strange ability.
my-pervert-sytem:
“Why is my system a pervert?”
[Quest Issued: Squeeze Head Cook Elara’s left breast and call her a 'bad girl'.]
[Reward: Mana Core Awakening.]
[Failure Penalty: Immediate and explosive detonation of the Host's testicles.]
Dying and transmigrating to a magical world was supposed to be the start of a glorious, overpowered fantasy life. Instead, Leon woke up as a malnourished servant in House Sterling, a noble estate ruled by haughty, terrifyingly strong, and impossibly beautiful women who treat him like dirt.
For five days, he prayed for a golden finger to save him. When it finally arrived, it wasn't a heroic guide or a martial arts system. It was the Pervert System.
Now, his only path to power—and survival—is tied entirely to his shamelessness.
Want to awaken magic? Grope the furious head maid. Want superhuman strength? Steal the untouchable noble daughter’s panties. Want to become the strongest Aura Knight in the realm? Well... that's going to require some truly degenerate behavior.
Leon didn't want to be a menace to society, he just wanted to keep his manhood intact.…
omnipotent-sage:
Invincible fists, unrivaled hammers!
Junior Leopard, who traveled through time and space, takes what he earns and does only what he needs to do, never undertaking too much responsibility nor being so chivalrous as to do every good deed. His so-called ambitions from his past life to change the world were cast aside.
However, when a forbidden bloodline awakens in his body and his eternal eyes begin to shine once again, he discovers that his iron fists give him the power to force others to follow the truth and to reforge justice!
This is a cultivation legend about a modern man that was thrust into an amazing martial arts world.
re-birth-the-beginning-after-the-end:
Li Hua's reign as the twenty-first century's deadliest assassin ended in fire and betrayal. Her own sister, Li Min, turned their elite force against her, leaving nothing but ashes where a legend once stood.
In the moment of her death, Li Hua's soul tore free from its earthly bonds, hurtling across the boundaries between worlds until it anchored itself in a new vessel in a realm of ancient martial arts and mystical cultivation. Through this impossible transition, her inner space remained intact—and with it, Little Firefly, her spirit companion.
Here, where qi flows like rivers and mountains bow to those who master their cultivation, Li Hua will forge herself anew. No longer content to be merely an assassin of mortal flesh, she sets her sights on ascending to immortality itself—a journey that will shake the very foundations of heaven.
rebirth-in-1980-the-farm-wife-makes-a-co:
In this world, there are people who are born to suffer. They have no home, no children, no relatives, and even die tragically at the end, just like Qin Xiangnuan, who carried her burdens alone. In her thirties, she is just a flower that bloomed only to wither in her declining years, and she also has nothing.
There are also those who are born to enjoy blessings, possessing wealth, beauty, a capable husband, and smart, beautiful children, yet they still take someone else's life, just like Qin Xiangmei. Though being biological sisters, she plotted against her sister from childhood until her death.
If it weren't for rebirth, Qin Xiangnuan would never have known that her half-sister, Qin Xiangmei, not only took away her father and her elder brother's life but also the only keepsake her mother had left for her, and even a tremendous opportunity.
start-with-the-mangekyo-sharingan-follow:
“On that day, not a single clan member was willing to follow me...”
In the early days of Konoha's founding, Uchiha Madara left the village. Before his departure, he called upon the entire clan, yet in the vast clan territory, not a single person was willing to join him...
Just as he was losing hope, a young boy stepped forward!
Madara was shocked to discover that the boy, despite his young age, had awakened the Mangekyō Sharingan! Not only was the boy's strength extraordinary, but he also knew the whereabouts of the Uchiha's secret weapon from years ago—Uchiha Hikari!
And so, the three Uchiha formed a new team...
Years later, Shin'u stood at the pinnacle, gazing down at the allied shinobi forces below and the Ōtsutsuki in the sky, a faint smile playing on his lips.
“Lord Madara, back then, your fists weren't fast enough, nor were they ruthless enough...”
[Single Female Lead, but Uchiha Hikari]
story-about-buying-my-classmate-once-a-w:
Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai.
The 5,000 yen is to buy three hours of Sendai’s time, which gives the right for Miyagi to give her orders.
Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who never crossed paths at school, spend time together after school under such a contract.
Miyagi’s orders are determined by her mood of the day, and Sendai cannot disobey.
One day after school…
Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an order that she usually does not give.
take-my-breath-away:
“Drive this woman out!”
“Throw this woman into the sea!”
When he doesn’t know Debbie Nian’s true identity, Carlos Huo cold-shoulders her.
“Mr. Huo, she is your wife,” Carlos’ secretary reminded him. Hearing that, Carlos gives him a cold stare and complained, “why didn’t you tell me earlier?”
From then on, Carlos spoils her rotten. Little did everyone expect that they would get a divorce.
the-fake-heiress-seven-brothers-pampers-:
He Jing transmigrated into a book and into the body of a fake heiress in a wealthy family. Overnight, she went from heaven to hell.
In the original storyline, the fake heiress resented the real heiress for stealing her position. She constantly opposed her, unaware that the real heiress had the halo of the female lead, and ultimately self-destructed successfully.
After He Jing transmigrated, she quickly set three goals for herself: stay away from the female lead, stay away from the male lead, and live her own life in the slums.
However, her seven supposed poor brothers became influential figures in their respective fields, and she effortlessly turned her life around!
Even the male lead, who had originally called off their engagement, now...
He Jing: “I'm sorry, we can't be together.”
Male lead: “Why?”
He Jing: “I only like your character settings in the story.”
the-law-of-attraction:
It all started with a stolen kiss on their first encounter.
“Miss Lana Huang… Expect a notice of harassment on your doorway soon…”
That was what Lana got for kissing a stranger to save herself from an unwanted arranged marriage.
“As far as I remember, you kissed me back fiercely and even dominated the entire kiss. You clearly had enjoyed your moment with me, so please don’t make it sound like I took undue advantage of you! And I told you, I’m ready to compensate you!”
“And how do you plan to do that, huh?” Liam stepped closer, trying to intimidate the proud woman who did not even bat an eyelid under his suffocating pressure.
Lana stepped backwards a few steps, raised her hand and growled, “Stop right there Attorney Sy if you don’t wanna taste the pain of getting kicked on your balls after getting kissed!”
Meet Lana Huang, a proud woman who climbed the ladder of success in her career. A lawyer and a bold woman, exceptionally beautiful to make men dream and drool for her. Love was the last thing on her schedule because she was a man hater…
But fate wanted to play a trick on her as she unintentionally kissed Liam Sy, a wealthy, powerful and arrogant man.…
the-protagonist-system:
You have all read about Self Inserts and their adventures. Some are good, some are bad. All of them are entertaining. What would happen if the person involved had a choice about who they could become? What would they do? Be good? Be Bad? Have more fun than anyone ever deserves?
Join me as we explore a brand new Gamer-like existence with The Protagonist System!

Warning: I will not apologize that this story is completely wish fulfillment. It's a story and I'm going to have fun with it.
the-versatile-master-artist:
“He is the highest-paid artist in history, and the very reason children fall in love with art!” — The New York Times.
“Fusing East and West, drawing upon the strengths of countless masters, he is the most brilliant graduate in the two-century history of HFBK-Hamburg.” — President Martin Köttering.
“We have witnessed the overnight rise to fame of countless artists here… Tonight, a new name will be added to the ranks of these greats.” — Venice Biennial.
Gu Weijing discovered that he had inexplicably acquired an Art Experience System. This brought a sudden turning point to a life that had recently been plagued by considerable troubles.
Adolph Menzel, Wang Wei, Titian, Picasso… Standing upon the shoulders of these masters, Gu Weijing chose to pursue the path of true artistic nobility.
you-have-science-i-have-martial-arts:
Ye Qingzhou, a swordsmanship prodigy from the Earth, is blown by a cruise missile to the Blue Star, a world flourishing in martial arts, embarking on a journey to seek the ultimate realm of the sword.
“Where is this?”
“Of course, this is the school's medical room.”
“Medical room? I think I just got hit by a cruise missile...”
